diagnosis: The original proof inducts on `post`, so it must repeatedly destruct the separate normalization derivation and manually compose subset relations. Inducting directly on `NormalizedOldExpr post` aligns each induction hypothesis with the corresponding subexpression; after unfolding variable extraction and membership, simplification plus `grind` discharges the constructor cases.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  induction h <;>
    simp_all [OldExpressions.extractOldExprVars,
      Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
      List.Subset] <;>
    grind
